Meta.title: convenr
Meta.description: Find a time that works for the whole group. Free, no account, no ads.

Start.heading: Find a time that works for everyone
Start.lead: Create an event, share the link, and see when the group overlaps. No account needed.

Create.name: Name
Create.descriptionHint: For example the place, or what to bring. At most 500 characters.
Create.weekdaysHint: No dates, for example for a weekly practice. Everyone sees the same times.
Create.zoneHint: Participants in another zone see the times converted to their own.
Create.fixProblems: The event cannot be created. Fix the marked fields.
Create.failed: The event could not be created. Please try again.

problem.name: Enter a name of at most 100 characters.
problem.description: The description can have at most 500 characters.
problem.referenceZone: Choose a time zone from the list.
problem.E2_range-reversed: The last day cannot be before the first.
problem.E2_too-many-dates: An event can have at most 31 days.
problem.E2_date-in-past: Days cannot be in the past.
problem.E3_out-of-day: Times must be between 0:00 and midnight.
problem.E3_end-not-after-start: The end must be after the start.
problem.E3_not-on-slot-boundary: Start and end must fit the slot length.
problem.firstDayOfWeek: Choose the day the week starts on.

Created.heading: Your event is ready
Created.adminWarning: The admin link cannot be recovered. Save it before you close this page.
Created.missing: The admin link is shown only in the browser that created the event. Here is the link for participants.

Manage.heading: Manage: {name}
Manage.invalid: This admin link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it.
Manage.comingSoon: Editing and deleting the event arrive in the next version.

Event.deletion: the event will be deleted on {date}
Event.shownInZone: The grid shows times in your zone, {zone}.
Event.weekdaysNotConverted: Times are in {zone} and are not converted to your time.
Event.legendLabel: The color shows how many of {total} are available
Event.groupHint: Point at a slot, tap it, or move to it with the keyboard to see who is available.
Event.meHint: Tap a slot or drag across slots with a finger or the mouse. Keyboard: arrows, Space, and Shift with an arrow to select a rectangle. Dark means you are available.
Event.joinFirst: Join above to fill in your availability.
Event.failed: Saving failed. Your edits are still in the grid; please try again.
Event.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. They are lost if you leave editing now.
Event.filterHint: Choose a name to see only that participant's availability. Choose it again to return to the group.

Join.heading: Add your availability
Join.name: Your name
Join.note: The name and password apply only to this event. A password stops others from changing your availability.
Join.leaveConfirm: Leave the event? Your availability and password are deleted and the name {name} becomes free.

problem.invalid-name: Enter a name of at most 40 characters.
problem.password-required: This name is already used in this event and has a password. Enter the password.
problem.locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again at {time}.
problem.not-joined: This browser is no longer joined to the event. Please join again.
problem.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
